```python
from math import gcd

def simplify(x, n):
    # Parse the fractions
    a, b = map(int, x.split("/"))
    c, d = map(int, n.split("/"))

    # Reduce both fractions
    g1 = gcd(a, b)
    g2 = gcd(c, d)
    a //= g1
    b //= g1
    c //= g2
    d //= g2

    # Compare the reduced fractions
    return a == c and b == d
```
